title: Banda’s Stay in Chamba and Reports to Bahadur Shah

blocks.text: The Chamba episode now presents Banda as an exalted guest whose reputation keeps rising in the hills. The ruler worshipped him with unusual devotion, and the narrative remembers Banda stayed in the hill state long enough for household arrangements and marriages in Chamba to be attached to his name.

From that protected hill setting the page swings back into imperial politics. Reports carried to Bahadur Shah describe Baj Singh’s violence, Sikh raids, and a Punjab landscape that no longer looks securely Mughal.

The result is a sharp narrative turn from local reverence to imperial alarm. By the end of the page, the Chamba stay matters chiefly because it frames the news that Punjab was slipping from Mughal control.
